answer: To enter, an applicant locks a marble bond and must collect endorsements from three sponsor wells at a published harbor, but only after completing an oasis of six unpaid work-leaves whose start times are drawn from a public delay lottery. Each well countersigns the leaf-set hash plus the applicant address onto the marble, which is then spent. At epoch close, clustering groups applicants who share a well, a key-family prefix, or a near-identical oasis delay skeleton; those marble bonds are burned, and the overlapping wells are barred from endorsing for two epochs.
